top_band: Reddish-brown rows 0-4 with small texture marks, then an orange front-edge line at rows 5-6
evidence: Down the middle column there is a top band (rows 0-4), a lighter orange edge line (rows 5-6), and a dark brown eave shadow (rows 7-9). This matches the guide's cabinet (top 5 + edge + eave). The top tone is close to the front tone, so the pass is marginal but the construction checks are all met.
